newsitem.title: UK: BT sinks again as market awaits AGM news.
newsitem.headline: BT sinks again as market awaits AGM news.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc eased again on Wednesday in a rising market amid nervous anticipation of today's shareholders' meeting, analysts said.
The stock fell 10p to 442-1/2p, having fallen 4p on Tuesday, also in a rising overall market.
"It's all about the AGM and what they are going to say about the MCI merger. It's just worry," said one analyst.
Much speculation and anxiety over BT's $24 billion prospective merger with American telephone operator giant MCI has circulated the market since MCI's surprise profit warning last week.
BT was also the most heavily traded stock in the London market with more than three million changing hands in early trading.
